researchScope: Tencent Cloud Coding Plan, personal and enterprise Token Plan, and TokenHub PAYG API

comparisonPolicy.enterprisePoints: published points per million tokens multiplied by the CNY 0.01 list price per point

providers.name: 腾讯云 Coding Plan
providers.notes: Request quotas are published, but Tencent does not publish a request-to-token conversion. Support-only offers are intentionally non-comparable.

providers.name: 腾讯云 Token Plan
providers.notes: Contains personal General/Hy plans and enterprise Professional/Light plans. Personal and Light plans deduct input, cache-hit input, and output tokens 1:1; Professional plans use published per-model point coefficients.

providers.name: 腾讯云 TokenHub API
providers.notes: Official PAYG rates for Guangzhou, Singapore, and the published Guangzhou batch models. Direct-supply and standard routes remain separate offers.

plans.name: Lite
plans.notes: No official request-to-token conversion is published.

plans.notes: No official request-to-token conversion is published.
